coverage_denominator: all before-version elements under <body> (element id = css_path K1-string); null K2 counts as absent
false_match: for K3,K4,K5,K7,K8 only; a pair false-matches if its before key equals the key of at least one DIFFERENT after-element (by element id); stability and false-match can both be true for ambiguous keys; K2/K9 are coverage-only (never scored for false-match); K1 and K6 are never scored for false-match (K1 is unique for pairs by construction; K6 chain includes the element's own K4 and is measured for stability/coverage/uniqueness only)
ground_truth: same-element iff normalized outerHTML (K1 key value) equal AND unique in both versions; recomputed independently per event from the rebuilt pages
k1_note: K1's key VALUE is the normalized outerHTML (element id is the css_path). Pairs are matched on K1 equality, so K1 stability is 1.0 and K1 false-match is 0.0 for pairs by construction; K1 uniqueness/coverage over all elements remain informative.

keys.K1: normalized full outerHTML: deep copy, attributes sorted recursively, lxml HTML serialization with with_tail=False, whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces
keys.K6: K4(element)|K4(parent)|K4(grandparent), '' if ancestor missing or above body
keys.K8: K5|sibling-index-among-same-K5-siblings (0-based, siblings restricted to elements under body)

null_k2: null K2 counts as absent: not covered, not unique, not stable, not false-matching; stays in denominators

rate_definitions.coverage: share of before-version elements (denominator: all elements under body) for which the key is present (non-null)
rate_definitions.false_match: share of COVERED pairs whose before key equals the key of at least one different after-element; scored for K3,K4,K5,K7,K8 only
rate_definitions.stability: share of COVERED pairs whose key value is equal in before and after
rate_definitions.uniqueness: share of before-version elements whose key value occurs exactly once among before-version elements (null K2 never unique)

recompute_qa: each result records event_recomputed (kind/positions/counts/matched re-derived on the rebuilt pages with Assignment 10's exact group_events logic and member key) and event_reproduced_in_rebuild (true iff kind, positions, before_count, after_count, matched all equal the source event row)
relation: per before-element: 'in' = the element itself is the inserted/removed element (checked literally per spec; provably empty for K1-matched pairs because K1 equality implies the member key exists in both versions, so no pair can satisfy it); 'above'/'below' = member of the changed sibling group lying above / at-or-below the event's recorded insertion/removal position(s) (insert: before-member's matched after-position vs min(positions); remove: before-index vs positions); 'outside_group' = not a member of the changed sibling group. Unresolvable containers put all elements in 'outside_group'.
undefined_rates: a rate with a zero denominator is null and excluded from event-rate medians
units: all rates are shares in [0,1]; counts are integers
